(term, id, cost), cost = edit + phonetic (phonetic ≤ 0 = sound-alike discount)
Unit = u64 view · collapses one LEB128 varint
per step over a byte carrier (u8 trie / char DAWG)
S(w│h) = f(h·w)/f(h) else α·S(w│h′) (drop oldest history word)
MAP decode in the log semiring:
ŵ = argmin_w c_lex(x│w) + c_gram(x│w) + λ·(−log S(w))
left→right; per token xᵢ, from each hypothesis (emitted words, history h, cost g):
— every T_lex candidate w : + c_lex + λ·(−log S(w│h))
— drop xᵢ (removes an extraneous word) : + deletion_penalty
— bridged continuation v of h, with h·v·c stored (adds a missing word) : + insertion_penalty + λ·(−log S(v│h))
⟨s⟩ seeds the history · ⟨/s⟩ scored at the end · prune to beam_width · return k_best
up to k_best hypotheses, lowest cost first
